checks.name: isolation_verified
checks.method: new API history; no filesystem/shell tools; current-episode callbacks only

verification.method: exact decoded RGB; proprioception atol=1e-8 rtol=0; configuration SHA-256

platform_limitations: Only exportable public model inputs, outputs and tool records are archived. Private/internal model reasoning is unavailable; this is not a complete model conversation.
The requested model and settings can be recorded, but the backend model version has not been independently verified.
The archive can verify recorded commands and declared recorder counts; it cannot independently prove that a command was never omitted by the recorder.
manifest_interpretation: Bridge manifest model_api_used/purpose fields describe the bridge defaults. The external dispatch, batch configuration and public model records document the actual evaluation; original manifest fields are preserved.
